Maya: Quick shoutout — huge thanks to the infra folks who fixed the Dedicated pool flake this morning. Demo stayed up and I owe you all popcorn 🍿
Junaid: Yesss, that rollback-on-a-whim trick worked. shoutout to Lina for the canary checks doc too — saved my afternoon. :raised_hands:
Erin: Incredible work. Also, huge props to Mike for triaging the telemetry alerts fast. Less frantic Slack = my favorite Slack. :sweat_smile:
Lina: thanks! I pushed a tiny update to the checklist in the repo: https://git.company/repo/infra/canary-checks (added a ‘when to escalate’ bullet)
ops-bot: Incident update — dedicated-gpu-pool: RECOVERED. Runbook executed: canary-rollback-v2. Tags: @oncall, @infra.
Mike: nice teamwork. quick morale idea: popcorn & movie Friday? tiny celebration for the save.
Maya: love that. i can bring a popcorn maker and two boxes of kernels. who’s in?
Erin: count me in. would love a relaxed afternoon.
Junaid: in if we play 10-minute board games after? (also, thanks again everyone)
Lina: in! and uh, I’ll bring caramel sauce. :drooling_face:
Maya: OK — popcorn bar it is. one last thanks: everyone who hopped on the call and kept the runbook calm, you were awesome. :heart:
Mike: +1 to teamwork vibes. small wins matter.
Erin: agreed — glad we have such a quick-response crew.
Junaid: also posting a puppy pic in the thread for morale: https://imgur.com/example-puppy.jpg :dog:
Lina: 11/10 morale boost. :sparkles:
Maya: thread locked for now — will DM logistics for Friday. Thanks again all! :tada:
